run_multinode_training: run multinode symbolic regression training jobs on a Slurm cluster using submitit
submit_grid_search_jobs: submit a grid search of hyperparameter combinations as Slurm jobs via submitit AutoExecutor
create_Trainer_class: create a Trainer class that wraps training args and handles GPU setup and checkpointing
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU rank, world size, and job directory from submitit JobEnvironment in Trainer
checkpoint_and_requeue: checkpoint the Trainer and requeue it as a DelayedSubmission for fault tolerance
